title: Fix deploy SSH timeout warning + SG docs

pr.title: Fix deploy SSH timeout warning + SG docs
pr.body:
## Summary
- Remove invalid `script_stop` input from `appleboy/ssh-action@v1.2.2`
- Set explicit `port` / connection `timeout`
- Document that SG must allow **TCP 22** from GitHub Actions (not only your IP)

## Note
The failed run’s real error was `dial tcp :22: i/o timeout` — EC2 SSH is unreachable from the runner. After opening SG 22 (and confirming the instance is running / IP matches `EC2_HOST`), re-run **Deploy to EC2**.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

commitMessage:
Fix deploy SSH action inputs and document SG for port 22.

Remove unsupported script_stop and require inbound SSH from GitHub Actions so deploys do not hang on dial timeout.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
diffText:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
index ee732b1..44b4e0e 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -31,8 +31,10 @@ jobs:
           host: ${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }}
           username: ${{ secrets.EC2_USER }}
           key: ${{ secrets.EC2_SSH_KEY }}
+          port: 22
+          # connection timeout (seconds) — not the same as command_timeout
+          timeout: 20s
           command_timeout: 2m
-          script_stop: true
           envs: POSTGRES_USER,POSTGRES_PASSWORD,POSTGRES_DB,DATABASE_URL,SESSION_SECRET,OPENOBSERVE_URL,OPENOBSERVE_USER,OPENOBSERVE_PASSWORD,OPENOBSERVE_LOG_STREAM,OPENOBSERVE_TRACE_STREAM
           script: |
             set -euo pipefail
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 574b56c..d1edc6e 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -67,4 +67,13 @@ Warm deploys target **< 30s** Actions wall-clock.
 | App dir | `~/temp-battle` |
 | URL | http://54.205.169.117 |
 
-Open security group **TCP 80** (and 22 for deploy). Manual redeploy: Actions → **Deploy to EC2** → Run workflow.
+Security group (inbound):
+
+| Port | Source | Why |
+|------|--------|-----|
+| **22** | `0.0.0.0/0` (or GitHub Actions IP ranges) | Deploy workflow SSH — *not* only your laptop IP |
+| **80** | `0.0.0.0/0` | Public app |
+
+If Actions fails with `dial tcp …:22: i/o timeout`, the instance is unreachable on SSH (stopped, wrong IP, or SG blocking GitHub runners).
+
+Manual redeploy: Actions → **Deploy to EC2** → Run workflow.
